summary: Frontend-only iteration 3 verification with two real browser contexts on the 'Niagara Nightly' 25/50 table. Multi-hand gameplay, BB preflop option, winner banner content, post-hand chat, leave flow and Admin search/pagination were all exercised end-to-end. Core functionality PASSES; however a CRITICAL layout regression was found: the poker table element renders at 0x0 px, collapsing the felt, all 6 seats, community cards, winner banner and countdown into an unreadable overlapping stack at 1920x1080.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL layout collapse: measured getBoundingClientRect() of [data-testid="poker-table"] = {width: 0, height: 0}. The felt oval is not rendered at all; all seats, hole cards, community cards, pot, winner-banner and next-hand-countdown are absolutely positioned inside a zero-size box and pile on top of each other in the middle of the screen (see .screenshots/table_layout.png and .screenshots/winner.png). Root cause: the page wrapper (line 161) is `flex flex-col justify-center` and the table container (line 182) is `relative mx-auto` with only `maxWidth: 900` and no explicit width. As a flex item with auto horizontal margins its width becomes shrink-to-fit, and because every child inside the felt is absolutely positioned the intrinsic content width is 0 -> width 0 -> aspectRatio 2/1 -> height 0. Playwright also reports the element as `hidden`, so it fails visibility waits. Fix: add `w-full` (e.g. `relative mx-auto w-full`) to the table container (and to the max-w-3xl action-panel/hand-info wrappers), or use `items-center` on the wrapper instead of relying on mx-auto.

Consequence of the collapse: winner-banner and next-hand-countdown wrap to one word per line ('NEXT / HAND / IN / 4S'), overlap the hero seat cards and are effectively unreadable; the hand info bar renders as 'HAND #5STREET: SHOWDOWNMIN RAISE: 50' (no spacing) because its max-w-3xl wrapper also collapses. Banner text/pill markup itself is correct — it must be re-verified after the width fix.
Because the table has zero height, content sits mid-viewport but there is a large empty black area both above and below; vertical centring cannot be judged until the width bug is fixed.

Stats card shows USERS 249 while admin-user-count reports '25 / 100 users' (and '50 / 100' after load-more). The 'M' total appears capped at 100 by the users endpoint, so the denominator contradicts the real user total and load-more can never reach the end of the list.

issues: Seats, hole cards and board overlapping in one 200px cluster
Winner banner + countdown text wrapping one word per line and overlapping hero cards

action_items: Add `w-full` to the table container (Table.js line 182) and to the `max-w-3xl mx-auto` action-panel/hand-info wrappers so they don't shrink-to-fit inside the `flex flex-col justify-center` page wrapper — this is the single cause of the whole broken table layout.
Re-verify winner-banner pill styling, non-overlap with hero cards and vertical centring after the width fix.
Make admin-user-count total reflect the true user count (currently capped at 100 while stats reports 249).
critical_code_review_comments: Table.js: absolutely-positioned-only children + aspect-ratio + auto margins inside a flex column = 0x0 box. Always give such containers an explicit width (w-full) or set the wrapper to items-center.
Add a lightweight visual regression/size assertion (table width > 400px) so a 0-size felt cannot ship again.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Functional/WS gameplay is solid — multi-hand, BB option, chat, leave and admin search all verified in-browser in iteration 3, so the next run only needs a short regression pass. The single blocker is the 0x0 poker-table CSS collapse in Table.js (needs w-full). Playwright cannot wait on [data-testid="poker-table"] visibility while the bug exists — wait on poker-table-page instead. Always clear seats before/after a run via POST /api/tables/{id}/leave for both QA users, and never run parallel gameplay tests against the same table.
rca_of_the_issue: Table.js line 161 wrapper uses `flex flex-col justify-center`; line 182 child uses `relative mx-auto` + inline maxWidth:900 with no width. Auto left/right margins on a flex item trigger fit-content sizing; the felt's only children are absolutely positioned so content width is 0, giving width:0 and (via aspect-ratio 2/1) height:0. Everything inside is therefore painted over the same point. Reproduce: log in, seat at any table, evaluate document.querySelector('[data-testid="poker-table"]').getBoundingClientRect() -> 0x0.
